data.one_liner: A customizable Nepali date picker for Flutter with Bikram Sambat calendar support.
data.what_it_does: Provides Material, Cupertino, and adaptive picker styles for selecting single dates or date ranges using the Nepali (Bikram Sambat) calendar system. It supports calendar dates from 1970 BS to 2250 BS and includes localization features.
use_when: You are building a Flutter application that targets users in Nepal.
You need to handle Bikram Sambat (BS) calendar dates and date ranges.
You want consistent Material or Cupertino styling for your date pickers.
avoid_when: Your application only requires the standard Gregorian calendar.
You need a general-purpose non-Nepali date picker.
strengths: Full Bikram Sambat calendar support spanning 1970 BS to 2250 BS.
Offers Material, Cupertino, and adaptive date picker styles.
Supports both single date and date range selection.
weaknesses: Limited use cases outside of Nepali localization and calendar requirements.
Requires specific newer Flutter and Dart SDK versions.
